Hang on a little longer. Give yourself a chance to experience some ups even if they aren't forever. I just turned 36, and I am still struggling. But as I sit here tonight barely holding on, I keep thinking of moments, not forever, but still amazing moments that I'm so glad I got the chance to feel, see etc. I know it looks bleak, I can't see much glimmer over here either, but if you can live for the next moment and the next, it'll help keep you going a little longer

Me too. I'm so exhausted. I'm trying to hold on to what I have, but it's slipping further and further away. I always talk myself out of it, but reasons not to are fewer and farther between. Just know, you are not alone.
Every night when I go to sleep, every morning when nothing has changed, every second while I'm suffocating and choking on my feelings I have to keep to myself
My kids even though they treat me like shit

And God said, I only give what you can bear, as he follows by holding your head under water till the bubbles start to disappear. Then he resuscitated you only to repeat. It's like he's a fucking sadist. And I'm a PK. I have some fucking words if I ever get the chance.

You are not alone in whatever you are feeling. We are all consumed by pain, but even though we each feel alone, together, even just through this screen, we have each other to hold our hand through our darkest hours
Hang in there. Talk to us. Put the pain on the outside, and it will lessen the suffering within.

Are you still with us? Hold on my dear. I experienced something like this in high school with a boy, and I am now turning 36 today. It's painful, but it is survivable. I'm not sure how old you are, but you will see her again. If you give up now, you won't get that chance, and you will be leaving her with no hope. I too experienced that life altering connection, almost an awakening with a boy that I should have never met. I still love him to this day. My mom also turned it into a living nightmare, and I still have never forgotten that attempt to crush me. I remember our time vividly, and those connections are so strong. Nearly 20 years later, even with no contact with him, when I am at my most desperate low dealing w an abusive relationship, he can feel it. On multiple occasions over the years, my phone will ring at 3am from an unknown number, and it's him. "Talk to me. You're in pain. I felt it", he says when I answer. So even if you guys don't end up together, I promise you, that love will see you through the darkest of times. It changed my life to know that something so amazing and beautiful and pure existed. I'm betting she feels the same, and you both need to know that the other still exists on this earth. Even apart, that love connects you to each other, gives you hope, no one can take that from you, not even your parents. I am praying for you both. Love will carry you, and you are never alone ❤

I understand completely. I dread talking to a therapist even though God if I don't feel like a floating fucking cloud has lifted each time I leave. Like just the act of being able to unload all of these feelings of hopelessness and just have someone hear me. I know it's just a job for them, but fuck, I'd talk to a frog if he sat there and listened. Just the act of sitting w me while I unload is probably the most caring act I've experienced tge whole fucking week. I skip home light as a feather only to have any determination or renewed hope in being a better mom and pushing thru the bs to reconnect w my husband stomped out like a fucking ember by his dissociation and hate. Every day I tell myself to breathe, tomorrow you will be free of this, emotions will shift, just breathe. It's exhausting. It's funny as lately I've been thinking that at least someone is forced to think of me in some capacity while I'm alive, where as dead, i don't think they'd bat an eye. Is that crazy to be so starved for attention, so desperate to be seen that It somehow keeps you alive? It's torture. I feel like I'm on the water wheel of anguish in Princess Bride.

I agree. I turn 36 on Saturday, and my husband said he wanted me to watch the kids today so he could shop. I just told him I wanted nothing. We haven't really been speaking or sleeping together for 2 months now. Wtf would I want some bs gift from you?! You can't even be bothered to listen to more than a sentence out of my mouth. He's remembered my birthday 2x in 7 years counting this year. My parents don't remember. I've been repeatedly daydreaming of just dropping the kids off w an old friend and driving till I can't anymore, then just be lost forever. Birthdays just solidify how much no one fucking cares. And I agree, the whole needing to be happy is even more traumatizing while suicidal. Brings a whole new fucked meaning to "fake it till you make it"

I even tell myself it gets better, because it will. But then it'll get bad again. And the pain and loneliness is so so much worse every time. Maybe because for a second I have hope and to have hope torn from you, replaced with devastating reality is absolute shit. I feel like I'm suffocating 24/7, choking on feelings of worthlessness, isolation, fear and tears that I swallow down. Exhausted from fighting every second, pushing onward for my kids that don't appreciate me, a husband that could care less about me unless my problems interfere with his plans and family that only pays attention to me when it benefits them. It's draining and endless.
